native_mechanisms: Two knot-cords laid crosswise over a sand-tray mark every place their symbols meet (a full lattice of symbol-pair crossings).

A single one-cell-wide ink-worm walks the eight directions and curls back over its own trail, re-testing a junction from another face, keeping no ledger but the sand itself, stopping only when no junction anywhere can still be improved (single-walker label-correcting relaxation with backtracking).
The worm crosses a furrow sideways spending no sand at all, letting one cord slip a step ahead of the other (a zero-cost gap move, one permitted stumble).
core_technique: Banded anti-diagonal (wavefront) Needleman-Wunsch with three rolling diagonals, one sequence reversed for stride-1 access, AVX2 8-lane int32 vectorisation, and band half-width bounded by 2·(Hamming distance)/5, with a two-row scalar DP fallback.
